title: Conditional κ = 0.00364665195644: fuse helper 319’s paid lifts
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Fuse helper 319's rank-five and rank-one lifts into one rank-six lift. The
complete signed 17-stage caller supports **conditional κ = 0.00364665195644**,
up **0.000000430519994** over exact #7314.

The 18-event chart-207 block has two exact rational identities. One routes
the removed direction to two peers already lifted to chart 127. The other
recovers helper 319's dirty return from those corrected values. The emitted
word changes the paid profile by `P1 −17, P5 −17, P6 +17` across all 17
copies. The complete bill has 110,519 paid and 22,461 productive positions,
surplus 1,424 and no empty-root credit. The fixed-profile packing relaxation
is about 0.005810141579, with 62.76% realized.

## Task and overlap

Changed scope of `p104-side-correction`, revision 8, on current main
`e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The parent is #7314 at
`9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91`, with the exact signed #7113
caller at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. Only field 319's
transport path changes. The constructor authenticates and regenerates
the exact parent from its retained source archive.

#7312 fixes a single intervening contact, #7171 fixes read timing, and
#7329 keeps the original scalar charts. This witness moves a coframed
component to its common legal clock and repairs both sides of the cut.
#6529 is an earlier compensated fusion on a different word. [Coordination
and local witness](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19552466).
The two exact #7257 commits are included as hosted replay prerequisites.

## Validation

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-helper-319-fused-return
    python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-helper-319-fused-return --check-modes --check-source-history

Local direct verification matched all 1,501 arbitrary-input output rows
and the literal COPY guard. The full native replay checks the chart maps
and phases, ownership, grid, precision, ordinary work and rejecting controls.
The complete signed replay checks 3,037 physical maps, 104 main
boundaries, the literal caller and all 54 strict and four functional outer
predicates. The signed ordinary bound is 782,715,464, and the precision
coefficient is 2,430. The old invoice rejects the proposed κ.
See [the package receipts](research/p104-helper-319-fused-return/README.md).

## Open next questions

Please review this candidate for the frontier. Start by checking the two
chart-207 identities and the 1089→127 phase on this exact head, then replay
the signed application. The five inherited framework assumptions remain,
with independent human or formal review and maintainer selection open.
